name: Rule of thirds
text: rule of thirds composition, subject placed off-center, balanced open space

name: Golden spiral
text: golden spiral composition, shapes curving inward toward the subject at the tight end of the spiral

name: Golden triangle
text: golden triangle composition, a strong diagonal corner to corner, subject where a crossing line meets it

name: Centered symmetry
text: centered symmetrical composition, subject in the middle, perfectly balanced mirrored sides

name: Radial symmetry
text: radial symmetry, elements radiating evenly from the center like spokes of a wheel

name: Asymmetric balance
text: asymmetric balance, a large subject on one side offset by a small bright element on the other

name: Rule of odds
text: rule of odds, {three|five} similar elements grouped unevenly, the middle one as the focal point

name: Pyramid
text: pyramid composition, figures or shapes stacked into a stable triangle rising to a high peak

name: Leading lines
text: strong leading lines, {a winding road|a fence|railway tracks|a long corridor} drawing the eye to the subject

name: Converging lines
text: converging lines meeting at a single vanishing point in the center, one-point perspective

name: Diagonal
text: dynamic diagonal composition, strong lines crossing the frame corner to corner, sense of movement

name: S-curve
text: s-curve composition, {a river|a footpath|a curving road|a shoreline} bending in an s-shape through the frame into the distance

name: Zigzag
text: zigzag lines leading the eye back and forth across the frame toward the distance

name: Strong verticals
text: strong vertical lines, {tall trees|columns|towers|poles} rising in parallel through the frame

name: Strong horizontals
text: strong horizontal bands, calm stacked layers stretching across the frame from edge to edge

name: Circles and arcs
text: circles and arcs, round shapes and curved edges echoing each other around the subject

name: Geometric shapes
text: bold geometric composition, clean intersecting shapes, triangles and rectangles of light and shade

name: Frame within a frame
text: frame within a frame, subject seen through {a doorway|a window|an archway|overhanging branches}

name: Tunnel frame
text: tunnel framing, subject at the bright end of a dark passage, walls closing in on all sides

name: Dark foreground frame
text: dark silhouetted foreground shapes framing a bright distant scene around all edges

name: Narrow gap
text: subject glimpsed through a narrow vertical gap between two tall dark masses

name: Out of bounds
text: subject breaking out of a drawn frame border, reaching over its edge into the margin

name: Negative space
text: minimalist composition, large negative space, small subject in an empty expanse

name: Blank backdrop
text: subject centered against a blank seamless backdrop, no props, nothing else in the frame

name: Fill the frame
text: tight close-up filling the entire frame, intricate detail, no empty space

name: Maximalist
text: crowded maximalist composition, every corner packed with objects, details and layered clutter

name: Empty center
text: empty center, subjects pushed to the edges of the frame, open space in the middle

name: Subject at the edge
text: subject placed at the very edge of the frame, partly cut off, tension with the empty side

name: Looking room
text: generous looking room, open space in front of the subject's gaze and direction of travel

name: Tight headroom
text: tight headroom, top of the head cropped by the upper edge, face pressing close to the frame

name: Directed gaze
text: surrounding figures' gazes and gestures all pointing toward one central focal point

name: Layered depth
text: layered composition, {blurred foreground elements|framing foliage} in front, subject in the middle ground, distant background, strong sense of depth

name: Foreground interest
text: strong foreground interest, sharp {rocks|flowers|a fence post|driftwood} large in front, scene stretching far behind

name: Atmospheric layers
text: atmospheric layers, ridges or rooftops fading paler with distance, stacked silhouettes in haze

name: Depth through scale
text: depth through scale, a near figure large on one side, a far figure tiny on the other, deep distance between them

name: Scale contrast
text: big and small scale contrast, a tiny subject beside a massive {rock|statue|machine|wall}

name: Forced perspective
text: forced perspective illusion, near and far objects lined up so they seem to touch

name: Pattern and repetition
text: repeating patterns filling the frame, rhythm of similar shapes, one element breaking the pattern

name: Receding rhythm
text: receding rhythm, a row of {columns|lampposts|arches|trees} shrinking evenly into the distance

name: Grid layout
text: grid layout, scene divided into a neat checkerboard of rectangular cells, like windows on a facade

name: Knolling
text: knolling arrangement, objects laid out flat at right angles, neatly aligned and spaced, seen from above

name: Mosaic of panels
text: mosaic of panels, many small frames of different sizes tiled together into one image

name: Diptych
text: diptych, two side-by-side panels showing related views that pair together

name: Triptych
text: triptych, three panels side by side, a central scene flanked by two related views

name: Split composition
text: frame split into two contrasting halves by {a wall|the horizon|a shadow line|a doorframe}

name: Hidden subject
text: camouflaged subject, a small figure hidden among similar shapes, found only on a second look

name: Color pop
text: isolated color pop, one brightly colored subject against muted gray surroundings

name: Juxtaposition
text: juxtaposition, two contrasting elements side by side, {old and new|natural and man-made|calm and chaotic}

name: Reflection
text: reflection composition, subject mirrored in {a still lake|a rain puddle|a glass window|a polished floor}

name: Shadow play
text: shadow play, long cast shadows forming graphic shapes that become the main subject

name: Silhouette
text: dark silhouette against a bright sky, strong simple outline, backlit shape

name: Low horizon
text: low horizon line, vast sky taking up most of the frame, small landscape below

name: High horizon
text: high horizon line near the top edge, ground or water filling most of the frame

name: Tilted horizon
text: horizon line slanting across the frame, uneven off-balance layout
